content: This paper describes the initial efforts in automatic humor detection in code-mixed social media texts. Corpus can be annotated with part-of-speech tags at the word level which may yield better results in language detection. Moreover, the dataset can be further extended to include tweets from other domains. Code-mixing is very common phenomenon on social media and it is prevalent mostly in multilingual regions. It would be interesting to experiment with code-mixed texts consisting of more than two languages in which the issue of transliteration exists like Arabic, Greek and South Asian languages. Comparing training with code-mixed tweets with training with a merged corpus of monolingual tweets in English and Hindi could be an interesting future work.
